title: Seven Network Limited - proposed acquisition of Unwired Group Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Seven Network Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Network Investment Holdings Pty Limited, proposed to acquire Unwired Group Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of the retail supply of broadband.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 25 October 2007 the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market.  Factors informing this conclusion included: - the absence of any overlap by Seven and Unwired in the retail supply of broadband; and - that the proposed acquisition may have enabled Seven to offer competitive bundled broadband services    to consumers in metropolitan areas.
